title: Automatic1111 (image generation)
description: An image connector for a local or self-hosted Automatic1111 server: synchronous text-to-image, no workflow needed. Gives agents a generate_image tool.
setup_notes: Automatic1111 (stable-diffusion-webui) must be started with --api and be reachable from the gohort server; the default port is 7860. It installs out of use: choose it under Admin > Capabilities > Image Generation, as the default or offered to agents, to put it to use. Configure on its row edits the defaults (size, steps, timeouts) afterwards.

questions.name: base_url
questions.label: Automatic1111 address
questions.help: The address gohort reaches it at, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:7860

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Letters, digits and underscores; the tool is named after it.

questions.name: prompt_suffix
questions.label: Append to every prompt (optional)
questions.help: House style added to every prompt, e.g. crisp, high-contrast, sharp typography.

questions.name: prompt_guidance
questions.label: Prompt guidance for the model (optional)
questions.help: Added to the image tool's description: this backend's quirks, e.g. put any words you want rendered as text inside double quotes.

config.name: api_key
config.label: API login
config.help: Only for a server started with --api-auth: its user:password. A local one takes none.
